Cloud templates for AI, development, web, and server management

With pre-installed templates on Aruba Cloud Compute, you can activate apps, application stacks, and management panels without starting from an empty configuration.

Choose the template that best suits your project, complete the necessary settings, and work in a configurable cloud environment with control over data, access, resources, and integrations.

All the benefits of pre-installed cloud apps

Get started faster, without configuring everything from scratch

Application templates reduce the initial installation and configuration steps, allowing you to dedicate more time to developing your project.

Maintain control and autonomy

Manage data, code, integrations, AI prompts, access, and configurations in a self-hosted environment, with greater operational control.

OpenClaw

AI AND AUTOMATION

OpenClaw is suitable when you want to design AI agents that perform actions, connect different tools, and orchestrate intelligent workflows. Start from a pre-configured foundation and immediately work on prompts, operational logic, APIs, and integrations.
